-- Bronze keeps values as delivered (strings); silver casts them to the
-- types its schema declares, until write-time enforcement exists (SPEC.md §2).
SELECT
  location_id,
  dealership_location,
  firm_name,
  address,
  city,
  state,
  zip_code,
  phone,
  CAST(opened_date AS DATE) AS opened_date
FROM (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
    PARTITION BY location_id ORDER BY _ingested_at DESC
  ) AS _rn
  FROM sales_locations_bronze
  WHERE location_id IS NOT NULL
) AS sales_locations_bronze
WHERE _rn = 1
